Jurassic Park

2025
Interactive AI cinema performance

Jurassic Park is a participatory cinematic performance, made with Johannes Büttner, that remakes the film through a real-time collaboration between the audience and an AI director named Mr. Neural. Staged at the Center for Performance Research in New York, it inverts the usual dynamic of AI art: instead of humans prompting machines, the AI prompts the humans. Using motion tracking, voice commands, and lighting cues, Mr. Neural directs participants through a hybrid film shoot in which the audience is both cast and crew. The performance ends with a screening of the result, an uncanny, AI-edited remix of the movie.
